spec_match.rationale: Recreates the spec's motivating example verbatim — a:navigation-source .thumb { view-transition-name: hero } — over real intercepted navigations with real document.startViewTransition morphs.

interactive.rationale: Thumbnails open detail views with genuine view transitions, the back link reverses, and every step is logged with the mechanism that performed the naming.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index promises the one-declaration replacement for the set-name-then-clean-up dance, with both mechanisms running labelled; the page shows both, including the fallback's cleanup step in the log.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles no-selector, no-startViewTransition and direct-URL-load tiers, and is honest that the back-trip naming is script in both lanes; rapid successive clicks (transition skipping) are not exercised.

references.rationale: chromestatus entry, spec section, and MDN View Transition API are linked.

conformance.rationale: The compound-descendant-parses assertion in the feature suite pins the exact a:navigation-source .thumb selector shape this demo relies on; the runtime matching contract is the suite's manual assertion.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP: autorun opened photo 2, the log shows JS-named thumbnail → view transition finished → name cleaned up → detail open = true, console clean, mobile emulation overflow-free; a missing hero background rule was caught in the screenshot review and fixed. The native CSS-naming lane needs a 156 build; the in-handler matches() sample and telemetry assert are in place for that run.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the probe, fallback branch, per-trip forward completion with mechanism, the native matches() check when supported, and the autorun detail-open outcome.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; thumb/hero tiles use accent backgrounds with ivory glyphs at large-text sizes (≥3:1), mechanism chip is stone/charcoal, and the fallback is labelled rather than restyled as native.

accessibility.rationale: Thumbnails are real links with captions and focus-visible outlines, the detail region is aria-live, decorative glyph tiles are aria-hidden, and the log keeps a textual history of the visual morphs.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360x740 DPR3: zero horizontal overflow, gallery collapses to tappable cards, no console errors.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Share a view-transition-name between exactly one old and one new element; in the dynamic-list-item pattern, set the name on the selected thumbnail and clean it up after the transition's finished promise.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The fallback lane implements that pattern exactly (set → transition → finished-cleanup, all logged); the native lane demonstrates that :navigation-source makes the set/cleanup steps unnecessary because matching is scoped to the navigation.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Cross-document morphs pair the Navigation API with view transitions and need the source element identified at departure.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Same-document scope was chosen deliberately so the demo runs on one static page; the cross-document variant is recorded as a suggested follow-up concept in the loading-links critique.

openQuestions.title: Confirm old-snapshot naming through :navigation-source on Chrome 156
openQuestions.detail: The forward morph depends on the clicked link matching during the old-state capture so the thumbnail carries the name in the old snapshot. Verify on a 156 build that the native lane produces the same morph as the JS lane with zero naming script, and that the name is gone once the navigation settles (no stale-name breakage on the next navigation).

openQuestions.title: Transition skipping under rapid clicks
openQuestions.detail: Clicking a second thumbnail while a transition runs should skip the first transition per the View Transition API. Exercise this and log the skipped promise rejection so the console stays intentionally clean.

summary: The motivating composition: :navigation-source naming the clicked thumbnail for a real view-transition morph, with today's JS naming pattern running as the labelled fallback and every naming/cleanup step logged. Verified headless on Chromium 141 (real morphs via the fallback lane, clean console, mobile clean); the native lane's equivalence is the recorded 156 follow-up.
